## Main concepts

| Term         | Meaning                                                                      |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Form         | An Excel workbook used to collect data.                                      |
| Form model   | A versioned definition of a form’s sheets, fields, layout and constraints.   |
| Consumer     | A package, tool or application that uses the package’s operations.           |

## Reference data and lookups

| Term                   | Meaning                                                                                 |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Reference catalogue    | A named collection of reference tables.                                                 |
| Reference source       | The location, cache and optional credentials used to retrieve a catalogue.              |
| Reference table        | A table of records used to interpret or check submitted values.                         |
| Lookup configuration   | Named columns and matching settings used to search reference tables.                    |
| Lookup index           | A prepared structure used to find matching reference rows.                              |
| Alias                  | An alternative value explicitly mapped to a canonical reference value.                  |
| Reference cache        | Local files retained after catalogue and checksum verification.                         |
| Reference snapshot     | Reference data and lookup settings retained for consumers to reuse.                     |
| Checksum               | A content fingerprint used to detect whether a downloaded file matches its catalogue.   |

## Catalogue mapping

| Term                  | Meaning                                                                             |
|-----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Mapping               | A correspondence between source and target reference tables.                        |
| Mapping configuration | The versioned YAML declaring the two catalogues and their mappings.                 |
| Source catalogue      | The catalogue whose reference values are being translated.                          |
| Target catalogue      | The catalogue in which the required reference values are resolved.                  |
| Correspondence        | The link from a source value to a value submitted to the target lookup.             |
| Correspondence file   | A CSV containing explicit `source_value` and `target_value` pairs.                  |
| DIRECT mapping        | A target lookup using the input or its CSV correspondence, without a source lookup. |
| REBOUND mapping       | A source lookup that reads another property and submits it to the target lookup.    |
| Mapping alternative   | One selectable correspondence for a target table; alternatives are not fallbacks.   |
| Mapping references    | Loaded catalogue data, lookup indexes and CSV correspondences used for resolution.  |
| Mapping result        | One row per input, containing its target value, status and resolution stage.        |
| Unresolved result     | A missing input, missing source record or property, absent match, or ambiguity.     |
| Provenance            | The selected mapping, configuration checksum, catalogue revisions and CSV checksum. |

Mappings are keyed by the target table; values are translated from source to target.

Catalogue aliases belong to individual lookups; correspondences belong to the mapping between catalogues.

DIRECT and REBOUND describe the resolution behaviour; the YAML has no `mode` field.

See the [mapping guide](mapping.html) for the configuration and runnable survey examples.

## R object classes

The package defines five classes used by its public API and one internal YAML marker.

| S3 class                  | Role                                                        |
|---------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
| `reference_configuration` | Catalogue sources and declared lookup policies.             |
| `reference_source`        | Retrieval settings, authentication and cache location.      |
| `reference_index`         | Reference rows and reusable matching indexes.               |
| `mapping_configuration`   | Validated correspondences between two catalogues.           |
| `mapping_references`      | Prepared catalogue indexes, correspondences and provenance. |
| `reference_env`           | Internal marker for a YAML `!env` value, consumed on read.  |

Each class has a help page named `<class>-class`, describing its creation, structure and use.

```{r class-help, eval=FALSE}
# Open the help page for prepared mapping reference objects.
help("mapping_references-class", package = "form.references")
```

Only `reference_source` defines a class-specific S3 method: `print.reference_source()`.

`map_reference_values()` returns an ordinary data frame with provenance, without a package-specific result class.
